column2: UPBEAT (Utility Performance and Behavior Today) is a data platform that tracks and compares performance data for selected electric utilities from around the world.

UPBEAT is financed by the World Bank’s Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP), a partnership between the World Bank and 22 partners to help low and middle-income countries reduce poverty and boost growth through sustainable energy solutions, and the Public-Private Infrastructure Advisory Facility (PPIAF).
UPBEAT data is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license.
